blocks.text: SCHEDULE: 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinals MANILA, Philippines–Converge secured its first-ever PBA semifinal appearance after finishing off Rain or Shine, 120-109, in Game 4 of their 2026 Governors’ Cup quarterfinal series on Friday at Smart Araneta Coliseum. Back-to-back triples from Mikey Williams proved to be the decisive moment that enabled the FiberXers to finally produce a breakthrough moment for the franchise that has been in the league since 2022. Williams gave Converge a 115-107 lead with 2:42 left in the fourth, ending any hopes of Rain or Shine forcing a deciding fifth game. The FiberXers ended a string of quarterfinal heartbreaks […]...
